assessments.mechanism: Statistical racing: incrementally evaluate candidates and eliminate weak ones as paired evidence becomes sufficient.
assessments.clean_scope: Automated configuration/MAX-MIN Ant System on generated TSP-like instances; exact efficiency ratios are setting-specific.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer to research-candidate evaluation requires a matched stopping/allocation study.
assessments.o_comparison: O has scoped Candidate evaluation and strategy-change triggers but no sequential statistical racing/elimination allocator with paired-evidence stopping.

assessments.mechanism: Retain diverse solvers and route each instance to a predicted-best solver, with cheap pre-solvers for easy cases.
assessments.clean_scope: SAT solver selection on benchmark distributions with engineered features; exact speedups are not transferable outside that setting.
assessments.uncertainty: O lacks a learned per-instance runtime predictor; only the structural routing principle is known.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly supports heterogeneous routes, scoped applicability and situation-dependent recursive routing, but has not evaluated a SATzilla-like learned portfolio.

assessments.mechanism: Decentralized randomized work stealing from busy workers' ready frontier queues.
assessments.clean_scope: Cilk/fully-strict multithreaded computation; benefit depends on sufficient parallelism and coarse-enough tasks.
assessments.uncertainty: No matched research-frontier transfer study is present.
assessments.o_comparison: O permits isolated parallel useful work but no work-stealing scheduler was found; main integration remains deliberately serialized.

assessments.mechanism: Optimization plus interpretable explanatory models and explicit hypothesis-breaking interventions so experiments yield transferable knowledge.
assessments.clean_scope: Nature 2024 materials/photostability setting; ~1.5% space coverage is not a universal speedup.
assessments.uncertainty: O does not fit an interpretable mechanism model from experiment streams or directly test the external intervention.
assessments.o_comparison: O already structures work as falsifiable units, objective evaluation, retained evidence, explicit falsifiers and strategy review.

assessments.mechanism: Minimize a failure-inducing context by controlled deletion/partition tests until a small reproducer remains.
assessments.clean_scope: Software-debugging evidence; dramatic Perl reduction is a case result, not average speedup.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer to O context/action failures is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: O records scoped failures/regression fixtures but no delta-debugging/minimal-causal-context search mechanism was found.

assessments.mechanism: Optimal computing budget allocation: allocate stochastic evaluation replications according to estimated design separation/noise rather than equally.
assessments.clean_scope: Winter Simulation Conference 1999 reduced 210-design supply-chain resource-allocation study. Estimated P(correct selection)=99% required budget 14,600 with OCBA versus 330,000 with equal allocation, reported up to 23x/~96% simulation-time reduction in that setting.
assessments.uncertainty: Finite-budget OCBA can underperform equal allocation; the 23x factor is not universal and a safe switching rule remains unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: Current O has no OCBA/ranking-and-selection budget allocator or noise/gap-based replication schedule.

assessments.mechanism: Choose actions partly for information that discriminates uncertain model structure, with probing fading as uncertainty falls.
assessments.clean_scope: Computers & Chemical Engineering 2019 nonlinear bioreactor simulation with finite structural hypotheses. Correct-model selection after change: 8.1h active-learning MPC versus 15.5h passive, 47.7% reduction.
assessments.uncertainty: Simulation and finite-hypothesis scope; no evidence of the same effect in arbitrary research loops.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly scores decision-changing information value and selects falsifiable discriminating units, so the principle is known; no formal dual-control/Bayes-risk controller or matched active-identification experiment exists.

assessments.mechanism: Diagnose slow-task causes and choose restart, duplicate, placement, or output protection by expected time/resource cost rather than cloning every laggard.
assessments.clean_scope: Mantri, OSDI 2010 MapReduce production/trace-driven setting. Reported ~32% average completion improvement; 21%/42% faster phases at 50th/75th percentiles; preferential output replication sped half of jobs by >=20% at ~1% extra network traffic; production copies succeeded 2.8x as often while only 0.47x as many were launched.
assessments.uncertainty: The ~32% combines several mechanisms and is cluster/task-structure specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O's Work recovery implements related stale detection, cause-sensitive gating, duplicate suppression, alternate-route continuation and resource/effect safety, but it has not evaluated a Mantri-like generic straggler policy or speculative-copy cost frontier.

assessments.mechanism: Randomly sample a tiny unbiased fraction of internal predicates across many runs and use aggregate failure correlation for low-overhead localization.
assessments.clean_scope: Cooperative Bug Isolation dissertation/cases. One bc-1.06 setup monitored 30,150 predicates over 2,729 runs; cited overhead ~13% without sampling versus ~0.5% at 1/1000 sampling.
assessments.uncertainty: No universal diagnosis-time reduction is established; many executions are needed and transfer to research telemetry is speculative.
assessments.o_comparison: O persists detailed invocation/tool/evidence records but no randomized diagnostic sampling or statistical failure-localization mechanism was found.
